exclusions.source_text: History of another malignancy within 2 years prior to the first trial intervention administration (unless the malignancy was treated with curative intent with low risk of recurrence \[e.g., nonmelanoma skin cancer, histologically confirmed complete excision of carcinoma in situ, or similar\] which are allowed to enroll).
Have known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or leptomeningeal disease (LMD).
Have active hepatitis B virus (HBV) or hepatitis C virus (HCV), or participants with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
